title: GPIO, strapping pins, and electrical limits

questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “GPIO, strapping pins, and electrical limits”?
options: ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.
Pin selection must be checked against the exact module and board schematic.
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
questions.answer: Pin selection must be checked against the exact module and board schematic.
questions.explanation:
Pin selection must be checked against the exact module and board schematic.
Why: Some ESP32 GPIOs are sampled at boot; others are input-only or reserved. Check the board schematic for flash/PSRAM, USB, and strapping pins, and respect chip voltage levels.
